WITH route3 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-74.066578 40.590315, -74.066573 40.590209, -74.066219 40.589802, -74.066169 40.589747, -74.066113 40.589716, -74.066045 40.589695, -74.06598 40.58969, -74.065915 40.589697, -74.065848 40.589719, -74.065801 40.589747, -74.065775 40.589768, -74.065743 40.589808, -74.065715 40.589857, -74.065711 40.58992, -74.065724 40.589975, -74.065747 40.590018, -74.065776 40.59005, -74.066331 40.59028, -74.066446 40.590317, -74.066578 40.590315))', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
route4 AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-123.058284 44.949283, -123.058273 44.949312, -123.058272 44.949341, -123.058644 44.950003, -123.058657 44.950046, -123.058665 44.950141)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip3 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route3 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
dem_clip4 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route4 r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT 1 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route3 r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS route_id, (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg FROM route4 r
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    ST_StartPoint(seg)         AS p1,
    ST_EndPoint(seg)           AS p2,
    ST_Length(seg::geography)  AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT
    e.route_id,
    e.seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p1)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p1) END AS z1,
    CASE WHEN e.route_id = 1 THEN ST_Value(dc3.rast, 1, e.p2)
         ELSE ST_Value(dc4.rast, 1, e.p2) END AS z2
  FROM endpoints e, dem_clip3 dc3, dem_clip4 dc4
),
grades AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_grade AS (
  SELECT
    route_id,
    SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0) AS g
  FROM grades
  WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY route_id
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN a1.g >= a2.g THEN 'Sand Lane' ELSE 'Patterson Street Northwest' END AS answer_name,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a1.g)) AS slope_deg_3,
  DEGREES(ATAN(a2.g)) AS slope_deg_4
FROM avg_grade a1
JOIN avg_grade a2
  ON a1.route_id = 1 AND a2.route_id = 2
WHERE a1.g IS NOT NULL AND a2.g IS NOT NULL;

WITH 
patterson_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-123.058284 44.949283, -123.058273 44.949312, -123.058272 44.949341, -123.058644 44.950003, -123.058657 44.950046, -123.058665 44.950141)')::geography AS geom
),
sand_lane_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry FROM roads WHERE road_name ILIKE '%Sand Lane%'
),
patterson_slope AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(rast, true, patterson_geom.geom::geometry), 
      1
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us,
    patterson_geom
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, patterson_geom.geom::geometry)
),
patterson_avg_slope AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Stats(slope_rast, 1, true).mean AS avg_slope
  FROM 
    patterson_slope
),
sand_lane_slope AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(rast, true, sand_lane_geom.geometry::geometry), 
      1
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us,
    sand_lane_geom
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, sand_lane_geom.geometry::geometry)
),
sand_lane_avg_slope AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Stats(slope_rast, 1, true).mean AS avg_slope
  FROM 
    sand_lane_slope
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN sand_lane_avg_slope.avg_slope > patterson_avg_slope.avg_slope THEN 'Sand Lane'
    WHEN sand_lane_avg_slope.avg_slope < patterson_avg_slope.avg_slope THEN 'Patterson Street Northwest'
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS steeper_road,
  sand_lane_avg_slope.avg_slope AS sand_lane_avg_slope,
  patterson_avg_slope.avg_slope AS patterson_avg_slope
FROM 
  sand_lane_avg_slope,
  patterson_avg_slope;
